title: Great app but unstable with data
body: Love the app and used it for 2 years with no issue but the other day all my data disappeared? I am on premium so restored from cloud but the last backup was from months of not years ago. Shouldn’t the app be auto backing up every day? I dealt with it any way and then 1 week later it deletes again so I uninstall and reinstall to try to reset the app and now the restore from backup isn’t working at all so EVERYTHING is gone. Very sad :(

author: Yogi-bob

title: Got a refund
body:
Changed to a subscription model after I already payed for premium.
Not worth the price after the change either so I got a refund and switched to another (and better) habit tracker.
Bit of a shame because it’s a pretty well designed app.
author: jek5n

title: Can’t access my previous purchased premium features
body:
So the developer decided to switch to a subscription based model. What a shame. What’s even worse is that I contributed to unlock the premium features but they still remain locked behind a subscription wall even if I try to restore my purchase. 

Pro tip 1: If you switch business models, make sure to get it right and let the people who once unlocked premium features have access to them in the future. If you decide not to, people will start rating the app with one star as I just did. 

Pro tip 2:  If you are encouraging your users to  contact you when facing issues make sure to answer them. If you decide not to.. well I guess I made my point.
author: Slippery_Pete

title: Scam
body: Last update removed my premium and is prompting me to purchase a subscription. No response to emails or Instagram. Will contact Apple for a refund.
author: planterka

title: Got premium and lost premium
body: Prior to the app switching to be subscription based I payed to unlock premium forever. It is fine to change your business model but switching suddenly and disable features that you’ve already payed for is wrong. I’m fine to not get any new features you might add for subscription users but removing something that was promised after “pay once yours forever” feels dishonest.
author: Dkrans

title: Switched to subscription based?
body:
I have been using this app for quite some time. It is sad to see that the app now require subscriptions. All of a sudden I am now asked to pay monthly for a set of features that I until yesterday already had access to. These features I have paid for and I do expect to have them at my disposal. So be it that I won’t have access to newer features, that is fair.. but requiring a subscription for already bought features, that I believe is a criminal act.

Users beware.
author: Peter Elfström

title: AMAZING APP
body: I have been searching for an app where I can have my daily planners, motivation and some notes. This is THE APP! I have tried some other apps but I didn’t really find anything good with them, I could only have three habits and then I had to pay a few dollars, around 50 which I don’t feel like cause I could use the iPhone app reminders but I don’t get how to do that app. Overall I like this app a lot, they overlay is good, u can have infinite of reminders and habits and it’s very easy to understand! Overall I give this 4,5/5 . I would like to give it 5/5 but I have only been using it for a day and so far I’ve been enjoying it a lot! I’m 13 years old and NEED some reminders, it’s an must. I recommend this app a lot!
author: i <33 roblox

title: Perfektion!
body:
Jag ville ha en app som kan registrera beteendeförändringar (egentligen en skoluppgift på mitt program på KI) som var gratis utan massa onödiga funktioner och störande annons element. 
Denna gör exakt det! Och i ett riktigt snyggt UI också (!!!) som gör att man ville öppna appen och kryssa för sina framgångar.
Jag överväger också att gå premium (riktigt sympatisk utformat premium pris - man betalar det man tycker det är värt!).
Jag vill ha flera sådana appar i appstore! Please!
Det enda jag kan sakna är att man kan registrera hur länge man utförde en aktivitet (i det tillfällen ett beteende (habit) är beroende av hur länge man utför den) eller lägga till kommentarer kring sina framgångar. Annars, som sagt, perfekt!
author: Awretling

title: I love it!
body: I’ve tried a lot of different apps with similair functions but the free versions usually include a lot less functions, this one has it all, which makes it much more likely that I’ll want to pay for premium version. The colors are lovely and it’s the only app I’ve tried that uses percentage instead of days. It keeps me motivated even if I miss a day and being able to personalize the reminder function is perfect, I haven’t missed a day of taking my medication since I got it. A solid 5 stars!
author: Hannyferb

title: Great app..
body:
I have currently used an other habit app for quite some time now but I think this app is more easy to use and have much nicer layout. 

I consider to go premium. 

- But why can’t you see your “motivate yourself note” anywhere? You have to go to edit your habit then you see it.

- Dark mode would also be nice 👍🏻
author: roggakrg18

title: Only truly free habit tracker
body:
So many apps claim to be free but only allow you to track 3 habits without upgrading and I'm pretty sure this is the ONLY app there that is actually and truly free free for unlimited use which I am so thankful for! 5 stars for that!
However... I originally got this app on my old Samsung and the interface is so much prettier there while on iPhone it looks like and old and abandoned app. Also, you can't modify the colours of each habit. If these two things were fixed I'd easily give it five stars.
I know some people would probably love being able to tick habits multiple times per day and/or add comments to each tick. I'm fine without it but that's a hint for future improvements :)) hope to see some improvements and that more people will then discover this honest app (developer)
author: IIMSD
